claims.claim: We use it to store water in our house and different places
claims.evidence: Usage history is not shown in the photo report; past use cannot be confirmed from images.
No food-grade certification or markings are visible in the witness report.

claims.claim: used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: Number of prior uses and what was stored are not shown in the photos.
Condition of the plastic, including cracks and splits, is listed as not shown; leaks cannot be seen in still photos.
Whether the black tanks have lids and fittings is listed as not shown.

risks.risk: Capacity in liters for each tank or tote is unknown
risks.proof: Close-up photo of capacity embossing or labels on each tank and tote.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unmarked / smallest standard size.

risks.risk: Age and whether items are new or used
risks.proof: Photo of manufacture date stamps or seller receipt showing purchase date.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with unknown age.

risks.risk: Plastic condition: cracks, splits, UV damage
risks.proof: Close-up video or photos of all tank surfaces, seams, and bottoms.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cracked or leaking (not water-tight).

risks.risk: Taps and valves may not work or may be missing
risks.proof: Video clip of the blue tap and any other valves running water without leaking.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tap missing or non-functional.

risks.risk: Metal cages may be rusted or dented
risks.proof: Close-up photos of cage corners, welds, and base.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as rusted or dented cage.

risks.risk: Black tanks may lack lids and fittings
risks.proof: Top-down shot of each black tank showing lids and fittings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as without lids or fittings.

risks.risk: Circular black item may be a liner or basin, not a tank, and size is unknown
risks.proof: Shot showing the item’s shape, depth, and any capacity marking, ideally with a person or object for scale.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a liner or basin of unknown capacity.

risks.risk: Items may have been used for chemicals rather than potable water
risks.proof: Seller documentation or a written statement of prior contents; chemical residue check.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as previously used for chemicals.

risks.risk: Stands or bases may not be included
risks.proof: Full shot showing whether stands or bases are present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as without stands or bases.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of capacity labels or embossing on every tank and tote.
Video of the blue tap and all valves running water.
Top-down photos showing lids and fittings on the black tanks.
Photos of manufacture date stamps on each item.
Close-up photos of the metal cages, especially corners and welds.
Full shot showing any stands or bases.
Shot of the circular black item with a scale reference and any markings.
response.reason: The witness identifies the goods as water tanks and caged totes, so a worst-case price can be set; every seller condition claim is unproven remotely and is priced at the lowest assumption.
